packageRules.description: Internal workspace packages are versioned by the changesets release pipeline, never by Renovate. Their package.json references use the workspace:* protocol and must stay untouched.
Group all non-major devDependency updates into a single PR and auto-merge once CI (lint, typecheck, build, test) passes.
Auto-merge the weekly Bun lockfile refresh once CI passes.
Hold every major update for manual review — these can carry breaking changes for consumers.

react-native-nitro-http-server 1.9.x declares peer react-native-nitro-modules ^0.35 and Nitro minors change the generated C++ ABI. Hold the dev pin within 0.35 so the workspace tests against what consumers install.
